remarks: Beautifully updated 2 bedroom/1.5 bath townhouse in the highly sought after Highview Condominium complex with gorgeous landscape and pool! Kitchen features stainless steel appliances, brand new bathrooms and brand new easy to maintain wood-like laminate flooring throughout. The first level also features a bright, open and spacious living room perfect for entertaining, a dinning room with a slider to a private Trex deck and a half a bath. On the second level there are 2 bedrooms with ample closet space, a full bath and the conveniently located laundry. There is also access to the attic for even more storage space. The complex is in the perfect location just minutes to the train, highways, restaurants, and shopping. 5 min walk to Norwalk Hospital! 60 min train ride to New York City! Please schedule your Private Viewing before it's gone!!!
